title: Remove Preflight From repo and Monorepo Setup
description:
Remove all preflight-related functionality from repo CLI and the monorepo setup. This includes:

1. Remove preflight command from repo CLI if it exists
2. Remove preflight references from package.json scripts 
3. Remove preflight tasks from .vscode/tasks.json
4. Remove any preflight-related documentation or configuration
5. Update any dependent systems that rely on preflight

The goal is to completely eliminate preflight from the codebase as it's no longer needed.
summary:
Successfully removed all preflight-related functionality from repo and monorepo setup:

1. ✅ Removed preflight script from root package.json
2. ✅ Updated all package.json scripts that used preflight to use nx directly (test, build, publish:test, publish)
3. ✅ Removed entire preflight section from .vscode/tasks.json (16 individual preflight tasks)
4. ✅ Removed preflight scripts from individual package.json files (compose/rs, compose/sketchpad)
5. ✅ Updated documentation to remove preflight references:
   - README.md build instructions and automation commands description
   - compose/js/README.md preflight section
   - compose/DOCS.md preflight section  
   - repo/DOCS.md preflight command documentation

The monorepo now uses nx directly for all orchestration instead of going through a preflight layer. All scripts and tasks have been updated accordingly.
